_doc.about: Series definition read by scripts/deploy.ts. Keys starting with an underscore are ignored. Copy this file, edit it, and pass it with --series. This example is a DEMO series on synthetic data.
_doc.collateral: Either the string "deploy-test-usd" (deploys the 6-decimal PiryTestUSD token, mintable only by the deployer) or the address of an existing ERC-20 with at most 18 decimals.
_doc.priceDecimals: Decimals of the index price (0-18). Bounds and reports use this scale. It must equal the workflow's index priceDecimals.
_doc.bounds: lower and upper payout bounds in index price units, decimal strings, lower < upper. A long claim pays 0 at or below lower and the full collateral at or above upper.
_doc.periodStart: When the measured period starts. Either an absolute unix timestamp (number) or "+N" meaning N seconds after the latest block of the target chain at deploy time. Must be at least 60 seconds ahead.
_doc.periodEnd: When the period ends and settlement becomes possible. Same format as periodStart, and later than it.
_doc.maxReportAge: Seconds a settlement report stays valid after its publishedAt. Keep it equal to the workflow's maxPublicationAgeSeconds.
_doc.fallbackDelay: Seconds after periodEnd at which anyone may settle the market at the midpoint of its bounds if the oracle never delivered. 604800 is 7 days.
_doc.index: Either { indexId, specHash } as 32-byte hex, or { terms } where terms is a workflow IndexTerms object. With terms the script derives both with workflow/validation.ts indexIdentity. priceDecimals, periodStart, periodEnd and maxPublicationAgeSeconds are filled in from this file and must be omitted from terms or equal to the resolved values.
_doc.receiver: { mode: "simulation" } trusts the deployer EOA (tx.origin) behind the Chainlink mock forwarder: DEMO ONLY. { mode: "strict", workflowId, markWorkflowId } pins the CRE workflow IDs of the settlement receiver and of the mark feed.
_doc.forwarder: Chainlink forwarder address. Monad testnet MockKeystoneForwarder is 0xB9F79d863261869B234c481D1f9A7af84AeAd192. On the local network that address does not exist, so a mock forwarder fixture with no signature checks is deployed and used instead.
